# SqlCursorContext

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Intellisense.SqlCursorContext`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Analyzes cursor position in SQL text using ScriptDom tokens and AST to determine the appropriate completion context. Falls back to token-based heuristics when the AST parse fails (partial SQL).

#### Analyze

```text
public static PPDS.Dataverse.Sql.Intellisense.SqlCursorContextResult Analyze(System.String sql, System.Int32 cursorOffset)
```

Determines the completion context at the given cursor offset in SQL text. Uses ScriptDom for both AST-based and token-based analysis.

- Parameter `sql`: The SQL text being edited.
- Parameter `cursorOffset`: The 0-based character offset of the cursor.

Returns: A context result describing what completions are appropriate.
